verdict: Organic signals softening; overdue milestones are being resolved this week.
narrative: Across all three entities this period, Google Business Profile was the only active channel — no paid spend ran on Meta or Google Ads. Combined, your profiles logged 389 total actions over the last 28 days, including 13 calls, 282 direction requests, and 94 web clicks, which shows steady organic presence even as week-over-week GBP engagement trended down across all brands. Search click volume is healthiest at O'Hare Precision Metals (446 clicks, 59,294 impressions), while Advance Grinding Services saw a 27% week-over-week search click increase — demand is present. Several milestones covering CRM buildout, outreach sequences, and site reindexing are due October 31st and are in motion now; completing these will unlock pipeline visibility and outreach that has been on hold. Next period you should see outreach sequences firing, CRM data becoming reliable, and a clearer picture of website traffic across all brands.
